idea-plugin.name: Class Graph
idea-plugin.description:
Node graph of your Java and Kotlin project.

Every class (and every Kotlin file) is a node; links show how they relate. Drag nodes, zoom, hover to highlight connections, and click a node to open its source.

Features

  • Links for inheritance, fields, method signatures, instantiation and method calls — switch each on or off.
  • Local graph: follow the file open in the editor and show only its neighbourhood, up to 5 links deep.
  • Search (module:, package:, name:, kind:) and custom color groups.
  • Color by package, module or kind, with a legend; node icons match the IDE's class icons.
  • Obsidian-like settings: arrows, text fade, node size, link thickness and the four force sliders.
  • Optional auto-refresh while you edit code.

Open it from the Class Graph tool window on the right.
